title: Before you reach for the tools

items.text: Watch the tank at feeding time instead of dropping the food in and walking off. You’re looking for any change in how the animals act, look or eat.
Check that the filter is actually moving water (a humming motor doesn’t prove it) and that the lights are keeping to their timer.
Read the thermometer, not the heater dial, and compare it with what your livestock needs.
Write down the temperature, anything odd and the last thing you changed. If you end up asking for help, bring the note.

note: Same for freshwater and reef. Keep up your usual testing and water changes too.
source_note: The note-taking tip is our own suggestion. This list is for looking, not a full maintenance or health check.
